name: Bounding Box Node Intersection
definition: A recursive ray traversal algorithm for a binary bounding box tree (BBNode) that determines the closest surface intersection by testing the node's bounding box, then recursing into left and right children, and finally comparing hit distances.
summary: Bounding Box Node Intersection is a recursive ray traversal algorithm for binary bounding box trees that efficiently finds the nearest primitive by pruning non-intersecting branches, unlike single-object tests.
